title: Strings
subtitle: Treat text as immutable code points; separate contiguous windows, ordered subsequences, and exact matching.
variables: n = input length; m = second input/pattern length; k = requested window/top-k/budget as specified locally; u = distinct symbols/values; N = total characters; L = longest word; r,c = grid dimensions; q = updates; R = integer range. Standard-library Python 3.10+, CPython list implementation notes where stated. Costs count scalar operations; arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic scales with bit length. Hash table bounds are expected, not worst-case; hashing a new length-L string costs O(L). Auxiliary space excludes returned output only when explicitly stated; sorting, slices and recursion are counted. W=number of words (including empty words); D=total dictionary characters; S=trie states; h=max pattern length; E=total copied automaton output IDs; z=reported matches; b=number of parity bits; H=verified rolling-hash hits. These symbols are local to the named templates.

decisionProcess: 0–30 seconds: restate output, empty/no-answer convention, indices versus values, mutation permission, input size and alphabet/value constraints.
30–60 seconds: separate contiguous ranges from subsequences or combinations; state brute-force repeated work and a concrete counterexample.
60–120 seconds: choose a family from the recognition cues; say its invariant and prerequisites aloud, rejecting a pattern whose prerequisite fails.
120–180 seconds: dry-run ordinary, boundary and assumption-breaking inputs; count copies, sorting, hashing, recursion and output before committing.
Mastery check: reconstruct the template without hints, justify each update with the invariant, test one counterexample to a tempting alternative, and explain a changed-constraint follow-up.

Set left=max(left,last[ch]+1), then record current index and update best.

Shrink while too many active types; delete zero-count keys, update best.

Expand until covered, record best and shrink while valid.

Shrink if length-maxfreq>budget; return optimum length, not unverified witness.

steps: Point at first unmatched query character.
Scan text forward and advance query only on match.

patternDetails.variations: Many queries via character index lists and bisect.

steps: Read backward with skip counts for erased characters.
Compare next survivors; both transformed texts must exhaust together.
patternDetails.related: Stack simulation is simpler but uses O(n) transformed storage.
patternDetails.variations: Backward skip compare; stack transform; word tokenization needs whitespace policy.

steps: Enumerate letter and gap centers.
Expand while equal; retain best boundaries or count each successful radius.
patternDetails.related: Manacher shares mirrored radius work to avoid quadratic expansion.
patternDetails.variations: Longest palindrome; count by centers; Manacher.

steps: Scan endpoints to first mismatch.
Try both one-deletion remaining intervals without copying.
patternDetails.related: Multiple allowed deletions require DP or bounded branching.
patternDetails.variations: One deletion; exact check; multiple edits need DP.

steps: Track run start.
At change or end emit run under agreed singleton convention, then join fragments.
patternDetails.related: Counter counts all occurrences; run encoding groups adjacent ones.
patternDetails.variations: Count every run; omit singleton count; char-list write pointer.

Closer must match latest opener; reject leftover unmatched opens.
patternDetails.related: Parentheses-only insertions may use balance; multiple types need nesting stack.
patternDetails.variations: Ignore unrelated chars only if allowed; one-type balance for insertion count.

Equal chars take diagonal; otherwise 1+min(delete,insert,replace) using correct old/current rows.

patternDetails.variations: Length rolling rows; actual sequence reconstruction; common substring differs.

steps: Initialize single-character intervals to 1.
Left moves backward, right forward; equal endpoints use inner optimum, otherwise skip one endpoint.
patternDetails.related: Center expansion is contiguous; LPS allows skipping.
patternDetails.variations: Minimum palindrome insertions n-LPS; careful old-diagonal rolling DP.

steps: Precompute palindrome intervals from smaller interiors.
Enumerate legal cuts with choose/undo or minimize cuts from prior palindrome pieces.

patternDetails.variations: Enumerate partitions; minimum cuts; count partitions.

steps: Define legal character branches and mutable path.
Choose/recurse/undo; parentheses closer permitted only when closes<opens.
templates: Generate valid parentheses via bounded DFS

steps: Count future availability and keep stack membership.
Skip used chars; pop larger top only if recoverable later, then push current.
patternDetails.related: Future recovery is essential for unique-letter stacks but not ordinary next-greater stacks.
patternDetails.variations: Distinct letters needs future availability; remove K digits uses budget.

steps: Prove repeated-length feasibility downward-closed.
Binary-search last feasible length; rolling hashes retain candidate starts, exact character comparisons verify all hash hits.
Keep witness bounds and allocate final substring once; the copy-based baseline remains for comparison.
templates: Longest duplicate substring by verified length search
Longest duplicate substring with verified rolling hashes
